values./system/biography: A Nuka-World service robot armed with a radioactive beverage cannon.
values./items/@15a3e7f56a49b3c8/system/descript: Body + Guns (TN 10), Radioactive, Piercing 1, Range C, Fire Rate 3.
values./items/@54ba4678d0f5d0b8/system/descript: This character is a robot: it cannot use consumables or heal naturally, and damage must be repaired. It is immune to hunger, thirst and suffocation.
values./items/@11ce4751d4448a10/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@22bcd38f46e0c5a8/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@98b977c6186af67a/system/descript: At 3 HP or fewer it self-destructs for 6 DC Energy damage with Radioactive and Blast.
